title: CSE - IIT Kanpur
description: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) was the first department in India to start Computer Science education. The department runs BTech, MTech, MS and PhD programs and is engaged in cutting edge research with sponsored projects and consultancies. Many of the nation's leading experts, educationists and consultants in computer science today are the alumni of this department. This fellowship is given in the honour of IIT Kanpur's founding director Prof. Kelkar and is awarded to young faculty members who are under 40 years of age and are conducting path-breaking research in their fields. Priyanka leads the IoT Vision lab and works in the field of IoT and computer vision. * Anjali Manoj, Harman Singh Bagga, Dhilipkumar M, Suraj Mandal, Priyanka Bagade, and #dbroy, "Generating Adversarial Side Channel Traces to Fool Power-Based Side Channel Attack: A Case Study on AES-128", *IEEE Computer Society Annual Symposium on VLSI 2026 (ISVLSI 2026)*, Kolkata, India.
